title: GenWave Icon Pack Definition (gw-icon-pack, schema-major 1)
description: The <slug>.icon.json shape a GenWave station fetches for a kind:"icon" catalog entry (app repo SPEC F130.1/F130.6, GenWave.Host.Icons.IconPackDefinitionParser — the single canonical source this schema is ported from). UNLIKE the other manifest schemas in this repo (font/theme/show, each deliberately types-only), this one pins the FULL closed shape the app's own parser enforces — a whitelist of seven SVG primitive tags, each with its own closed, additionalProperties:false attribute set, plus the exact `d`/`points` character grammars — because SPEC F130.1's own "script/hrefs/CSS/literal colors are inexpressible by schema" guarantee is precisely what this document's SHAPE is required to hold, not a load-time nicety layered on top of a looser catalog schema the way theme/font's CSS-safety checks are. What this schema CANNOT express (JSON's own number grammar allows a value like `1e400` that overflows to a non-finite double once parsed) is tools/validate.py's own job: it walks every numeric attribute and rejects non-finite values, plus enforces the ≤256 KiB definition-size cap (KindSpec.size_cap, mirrors the persona card's own CARD_SIZE_CAP mechanism) neither of which a JSON Schema keyword can express. Licence/provenance fields belong in the companion <slug>.meta.json, NEVER here (SPEC F130.6, amended 2026-08-16 at the T305 review) — tools/validate.py HARD-rejects a `license`/`licence` member appearing in this document, since IconPackDefinitionSerializer's own re-serialization would silently drop it.
$comment: Every pattern below ends in (?![\s\S]) rather than a bare `$` — the same portable absolute-end-of-string anchor schemas/index.schema.json documents in full; Python's re `$` also matches immediately before a trailing newline. The `d`/`points` character classes are copied VERBATIM from GenWave.Host.Icons.IconPackDefinitionParser's own PathDataText/PointsText consts, hyphen placed LAST in each class so it reads as a literal '-' rather than forming an unintended range with its neighbours (SPEC F130.1's own 2026-08-15 correction, PLAN T302/T305/T309 — this is the third of the three copies that correction note calls out, and the ONLY one still to author as of T309; the C# const's own comment explains the exact `+`-through-`e` range bug a misplaced hyphen would open).

schemaVersion.description: Definition schema major version (IconPackDefinitionParser.CurrentSchemaVersion, currently 1). OPTIONAL — the app treats an absent value as the current major (SPEC F130.1) — and, like show/theme's own schemaVersion, this schema pins the type only: a future major's own catalog-side schema update owns rejecting/accepting it, not a hardcoded maximum here.

style.description: The pack-level stroke width and fill mode every icon renders under (IconPackStyle).

fill.description: The only two fill tokens this schema can express (SPEC F130.1's "inexpressible by schema" ruling — no literal hue anywhere a pack can reach).

icons.description: Icon name -> element list (IconPackDefinitionParser.MaxIconsPerPack = 512 total icons). A pack may cover any subset of the house icon-name contract (CONTRIBUTING.md's Icon packs section) — a name outside it is still a syntactically valid entry, simply never rendered under a shipped UI slot today (SPEC F130.2).

propertyNames.description: IconPackDefinitionParser.IconNameText/MaxIconNameChars — lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter, capped at 64 characters. Gates the map KEY itself (not just element values), the same discipline theme-manifest.schema.json's TokenNamePattern precedent established for theme token names.

additionalProperties.description: One icon's elements (IconPackDefinitionParser.MaxElementsPerIcon = 64). An icon declaring zero elements, or more than 64, is malformed.

colorToken.description: Per-element fill/stroke override — the same closed two-token vocabulary as the pack-level `style.fill` (SPEC F130.1).

tag.description: The closed SVG primitive whitelist (IconPackDefinitionParser.ElementSchemas) — script, <use>/href, and every other SVG element are structurally absent from this enum, not merely undocumented.

element.description: One SVG primitive (IconElement). Which OTHER properties are allowed/required is pinned per-tag below (allOf/if-then) — each tag's own subschema is additionalProperties:false, so an attribute outside that tag's closed set (e.g. a `path` carrying `x`/`y`) is rejected here exactly as IconPackDefinitionParser's own AllowedAttributeNames check would reject it.

d.description: IconPackDefinitionParser.PathDataText — every SVG path command letter, digits, space, comma, period, sign, and the exponent letters e/E; hyphen last so it reads as a literal, not a `+`-through-`e` range.

points.description: IconPackDefinitionParser.PointsText — numeric geometry only; hyphen last so it reads as a literal, never a range.
IconPackDefinitionParser.PointsText — same grammar as polyline's own `points`.
